redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-production fixtures only.
Public official laws, regulations, pages, catalogs, specifications or viewers retained as references; access does not imply row or artifact redistribution rights.
An exact artifact whose declared licence or permission permits recorded fields and derivatives, with provider, edition, coverage, schema, CRS, validity, attribution and digest pinned.
Registered, request-delivered, licensed, operator-controlled or restricted material used and redistributed only as specifically permitted.
Personal, tracking, query, unclear-license, search-only, viewer-only or non-redistributable evidence may detect discrepancies but cannot become public output.

sources.provider: Government of Indonesia / Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs
sources.production_scope: Law 38/2009 defines Kode Pos as numbers, letters or a combination written after the city name and requires its use to identify an address or area. It establishes semantics and confidentiality, not a current assignment table, official surface or building relation.

sources.provider: Ministry of Communication and Digital Affairs, Indonesia
sources.production_scope: Ministerial Regulation 8/2025 states that postal codes may be numeric, alphabetic or combined and that the Minister establishes the numbering scheme to the smallest area. An exact ministerial schedule or dataset is required for assignments; this regulation does not itself supply geometry.

The official search validates a displayed current postcode and locality hierarchy at capture time. Public search does not establish a documented bulk API, complete history, polygon, delivery entitlement or redistribution permission.

sources.provider: Universal Postal Union with PT Pos Indonesia
sources.production_scope: The UPU sheet presents five digits after the locality and province, city or regency, district, village or urban village and RT/RW address context. It is an addressing reference, not a complete current code database, geometry, delivery point or building relation.

sources.provider: Province of West Java via Satu Data Indonesia
sources.production_scope: The portal dataset includes postcode plus BPS and Kemendagri province, city or regency, district and village identifiers and production year. It is published by a provincial agency and marked as still fulfilling Satu Data principles; exact resource provenance, coverage, licence, edition and digest are required. It is not national operator assignment or geometry authority.

A pinned ministerial decision provides official administrative codes, names and islands for its edition. These identifiers are administrative context and require explicit crosswalks to Pos Indonesia and BPS editions; they are not postal assignments, geometry or buildings.

Pinned BPS regulations or master files identify statistical work areas and village names for a specific edition. BPS identifiers require explicit crosswalks to Kemendagri, Pos Indonesia and BIG; they are statistical context, not postal assignment or geometry.

The BIG catalog provides versioned village and urban-village administrative geometry and states that non-definitive boundaries cannot be used as an official reference; metadata also describes equal-distance gap allocation in an edition. Exact licence or permission, edition, definitive status, coverage, CRS, topology and digest are required. This is never canonical postal geometry.

BIG publishes regional, scale- and edition-specific RBI BANGUNANFASUM and related topographic products. Each exact layer, coverage, feature meaning, licence or permission, scale, CRS and digest must be pinned. A building or facility feature is not automatically an exact civic-address match.

artifact_partitions.contents: Pinned current code with Pos Indonesia locality hierarchy, capture or edition time and source authority.
Versioned legal numeric, alphabetic or combined scheme records separate from the current five-digit runtime.
Exact ministerial or operator-authorized postal geometry with assignment relation, licence, CRS, topology and digest.
Optional versioned, uncertainty-bearing, non-canonical surfaces from permitted locality assignments and administrative geometry.
Kemendagri, BPS and BIG namespaces, editions and explicit crosswalks retained independently.
Neighbourhood, street, alley and premise evidence separate from postal and administrative geometry.
Exact rights-cleared regional building features and explicit civic-address joins, never inferred from postcode or proximity.
Source coverage tracked without geopolitical inference; recipients, correspondence, tracking, households, residence, ownership, private access and queries excluded.
